title: Patch: a Ctrl/Cmd+K command menu on the menu screens
thread: **Issue #2118 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #2118: Patch: a Ctrl/Cmd+K command menu on the menu screens Opened by @squishy-squooby. Part of #2036. This is a patch of its own: it goes live when it merges and builds on `main` beside the tracker's other parts. ## What Ctrl+K (⌘K on Apple devices) opens a command menu on every menu screen. - **Entries:** - every menu route the player can open, reached through `navigate()` so R1754000's leave guard still holds a move; - the common actions: new deck, practice, play; - a card search by name, over the shipped catalog only (`almanacShelf`, R1420: no unshipped card), whose result opens that card's inspect detail. - **Filtering.** Typing filters the entries by a case-insensitive match on their words in the player's locale (`t()`). - **Keys.** Arrow keys move the selection, Enter runs it, and Escape or a click outside closes the menu. - **Focus.** The menu is a modal dialog. Focus moves to its input on open, Tab stays inside it, and focus returns to where it was on close. - **Not on the board.** The menu is not mounted on any board route (match, practice game, hotseat, duos, watch, replay), so it never takes keys from a game. - **Typing elsewhere.** Ctrl/Cmd+K opens it even from a text field, but a plain letter typed into another field never does. - **Touch.** It needs a keyboard, so there is no touch entry point. ## Done when vitest checks that: - Ctrl+K and Meta+K open the menu on a menu screen, and nothing opens on a board route; - Enter on a route entry calls `navigate()`, and the leave guard still holds it; - the card search lists no unshipped card, and its result opens the inspect detail; - Escape closes the menu and returns focus; - Tab stays inside the menu. ## Ground rules (from #2036) - Read `apps/web/README.md` before changing the client. CLAUDE.md rule 7: nothing here predicts, enforces or reveals game state. - Every number is a named constant (rule 9). - Every animation and gesture follows Reduce motion: the media query, and `data-motion="reduced"` from the settings panel. - If SPEC §10 doesn't already decide a behaviour, add a ruling note numbered from this issue's own block (`docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Ruling numbers), with its proving test named after it. - Gates: `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e`. - The PR closes this issue, says `Part of #2036`, and carries one `## Player note` line. ## Plan _Written by `claude-3` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40587284879)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal On every menu screen, Ctrl+K or Meta+K opens a modal command menu. It lists three actions (New deck, Practice, Play), every menu page, and, once the player types, the Almanac shelf's cards by name (`almanacShelf`, so no unshipped card). - **Entries:** each runs `navigate()`, so R1754000's guard still holds it. A card opens its `inspect-detail` at `/almanac?card=`. - **Filter:** case-insensitive words in the reader's language. - **Keys:** arrows move, Enter runs, and Escape or a click outside closes it. - **Focus:** it moves in, Tab stays inside, and focus returns on close. - **Boards:** the menu is never mounted on one. SPEC §10.10 decides none of this, so it becomes ruling R2118000. ## Files to touch | Path | | What | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/game/boardShown.ts` | new | `useMarkBoardShown`, `useBoardShown` | | `apps/web/src/game/Game.tsx` | change | calls `useMarkBoardShown()` | | `apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts` | change | `newDeckPath`, `wantsNewDeck` | | `apps/web/src/routes/commandEntries.ts` | new | entries and filter | | `apps/web/src/routes/CommandMenu.tsx` | new | shortcut and dialog | | `apps/web/src/routes/command-menu.css` | new | look, no animation | | `apps/web/src/main.tsx` | change | mounts it | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckWorkshop.tsx` | change | `?new=deck` | | `apps/web/src/routes/almanac.tsx` | change | detail follows `useSearch()` | | `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | 5 entries | | `apps/web/src/routes/command-menu.test.tsx` | new | tests | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckWorkshop.test.tsx` | change | 2 tests | | `apps/web/src/routes/almanac.test.tsx` | change | 1 test | | `apps/web/README.md` | change | a paragraph | | `spec/rulings/R2118000.md` | new | ruling | | `spec/10-engine-guide.md` | change | §10.10 paragraph | | `spec/11-rulings.md` | change | entry | | `spec/INDEX.md` | change | via `cargo jackioh spec index` | Do not touch any crate, `e2e/`, a manifest or lockfile, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/` or `.claude/`. Add no dependency. Governing rules: - §10.10. - R630: the Almanac, and its `?card=`. - R1420 and R674: the shelf. - R711000: every `t()` literal needs a zh-CN entry, and cards are named with `readerName`. - R1754000. - CLAUDE.md rules 3, 7 and 9. ## Steps 1. **`game/boardShown.ts`.** - Use `let boards = 0` and a listener `Set`, emitting as `cards/inspect/store.ts` does. - `useMarkBoardShown(): void`: a `useEffect(…, [])` that adds 1 and emits, and on cleanup subtracts 1 and emits. - `useBoardShown(): boolean`: `useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, shown, shown)`, with `shown = () => boards > 0`. - Header: "R2118000: every board is Game.tsx, which marks itself here, so the shell mounts no command menu over a practice game or a replay, which share paths with menus." 2. **`game/Game.tsx`.** After `useLocale();` in `Game`, add `// R2118000: no command menu over a board.` and then `useMarkBoardShown();`. 3. **`net/navigate.ts`.** After `practiceDeckPath`, add these, with doc comments citing R2118000: - `newDeckPath()` returns `` `${paths.decks}?new=deck` ``. - `wantsNewDeck(search: string)` returns `queryValue(search, "new") === "deck"`. 4. **`routes/commandEntries.ts`.** Header: R2118000; every entry is a `navigate` move; the labels are built per call, from a render. - Shared definitions: - `const CATALOG = catalogJson as unknown as CardDefs;`, as in `almanac.tsx`. It is already in the entry chunk via `landingFan.ts`. - `export const COMMAND_MENU_CARDS_SHOWN = 8;` - `export type CommandEntry = { readonly id: string; readonly kind: "action" | "page" | "card"; readonly label: string; readonly path: string };` - `commandMenuOn(path)` is false for `paths.hotseat`, for `paths.duosDev`, and wherever `matchIdOf`, `seriesIdOf`, `watchIdOf` or `duosIdOf` is non-null. - `commandActions()`, in this order: - `action-new-deck`: `t("New deck")`, `newDeckPath()` - `action-practice`: `t("Practice")`, `paths.practice` - `action-play`: `t("Play")`, `paths.play` - `commandPages()`: entries `page-`, kind `"page"`, each label a literal `t("…")`, the path being that `paths` member: - `home`: "Home", `landing` - `decks`: "Decks" - `collection`: "Collection" - `creator`: "Card builder" - `shop`: "Shop" - `purchases`: "Purchases" - `almanac`: "Card almanac" - `patch-notes`: "Patch notes", `patchNotes` - `stats`: "Stats" - `leaderboard`: "Leaderboard" - `replays`: "Replays" - `together`: "Play together" - `account`: "Account" - `privacy`: "Privacy" - `terms`: "Terms" - `accessibility`: "Accessibility" - `copyright`: "Copyright" All already have zh-CN entries. - `commandCards(cards = CATALOG)`: `almanacShelf(cards).flatMap((id): CommandEntry[] => …)`, giving `[]` when `cards[id]` is undefined and otherwise `{ id: \`card-${id}\`, kind: "card", label: readerName(def), path: paths.almanacCard(id) }`. The imports are `readerName` from `../cards/chinese.ts`, `almanacShelf` from `../game/deckbuilder/shelf.ts` and `type CardDefs` from `@jackioh/shared`. - `matchesQuery(label, query)`: every word of `query.toLocaleLowerCase().split(/\s+/u)` is a substring of `label.toLocaleLowerCase()`. A blank query matches everything. - `commandEntries(query, cards = CATALOG)`: - Return the matching actions, then the matching pages. - When `query.trim()` is non-empty, append the matching cards, sliced to `COMMAND_MENU_CARDS_SHOWN`. 5. **`routes/CommandMenu.tsx`.** Header: R2118000; rule 7; no touch entry and no animation; modelled on `together/ChallengeDialog.tsx`. - Exports: - `commandMenuTestid = { scrim: "command-menu-scrim", dialog: "command-menu", input: "command-menu-input", close: "command-menu-close", list: "command-menu-list", empty: "command-menu-empty" } as const` - `commandEntryTestid(id)` returns `` `command-menu-entry-${id}` ``. - `isCommandMenuKey(event)` returns `(event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && !event.altKey && !event.shiftKey && event.key.toLowerCase() === "k"`. - `OTHER_MODAL = \`[aria-modal="true"]:not([data-testid="${commandMenuTestid.dialog}"])\``. - Default `CommandMenu({ path })`: returns `null` when `!commandMenuOn(path) || useBoardShown()` (read the hook first), else ``. - `CommandMenuKeys`: - Holds `open` state. - A `useEffect` adds a `window` `keydown` listener. On `isCommandMenuKey`, when no `OTHER_MODAL` is in the document, it calls `preventDefault()` and `setOpen(true)`. - `close` is a `useCallback`. Render `open ? : null`. - `CommandMenuDialog({ onClose })`: - Calls `useLocale()`, `listId = useId()`, the `dialog` and `input` refs, and the `query` and `selected` state. - `shown = commandEntries(query)` and `current = shown.length === 0 ? -1 : Math.min(selected, shown.length - 1)`. - `optionId(i)` returns `` `${listId}-${String(i)}` ``. - The dialog's effects: - Copy `collection/CardCosmeticsView.tsx`'s `useLayoutEffect`: remember the opener, focus the input, and refocus the opener on cleanup if it `isConnected`. - `useModalKeys(dialog, onClose)` from `together/modalKeys.ts` handles Escape and Tab. - On `[current]`, `document.getElementById(optionId(current))?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: "nearest" })`. - `run(entry)` is `onClose(); navigate(entry.path);`. - JSX: - The scrim: `div.command-menu-scrim` (testid `scrim`), whose `onClick` closes the menu when `event.target === event.currentTarget`. - Inside it, `div.command-menu` (testid `dialog`) with `ref`, `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"` and `aria-label={t("Command menu")}`. - The input (testid `input`): - `role="combobox"`, `aria-expanded="true"`, `aria-controls={listId}`, `aria-autocomplete="list"`. - `aria-activedescendant` is `optionId(current)`, or undefined when `current` is -1. - `aria-label` and `placeholder` are both `t("Search pages, actions and cards")`. - `autoComplete="off"`, `value={query}`, and an `onChange` that sets the query and `setSelected(0)`. - A Close `
